t: You're looking at Evelina London Children's Hospital, a specialist NHS children's hospital that is part of Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust. It sits alongside St Thomas' Hospital in Lambeth, and it moved here from Guy's Hospital in Southwark on 31 October 2005. It also provides teaching facilities for London South Bank University and King's College London School of Medicine. The name comes from Evelina de Rothschild, a member of the Rothschild banking family, who lived from 1839 to 1866.
